notes.title: Version 1
notes.notes:
The game is here, but it is not the end. 

When I set out to make disillusion I had wanted to create an experience nobody would experience the same way, something I could add to for some time. 

I failed that, as the Frame work was not really there. This new game, disillusion ST, was set up for such an idea, meaning I could add to it continuously.

Though I am working on a new project, eventually i will  get achievements working on this new game.
I don't quite know how to on rpg maker MZ.
